profile.headline: Software Engineer II en Microsoft
profile.summary: Software engineer passionate about changing the world, by creating solutions that not only solve people's problems today, but empower them to do more tomorrow. I do this one step at a time using Web apps and Machine Learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
●	Designed and implemented features in C# for internal chatbot in Microsoft, unifying sales and business processes from various teams, with over 38k unique users and 700k conversations in 2024. Technologies included Adaptive Cards, Bot Framework, Open AI on your data and other Azure technologies.
●	Handled security, compliance and accessibility processes for service above, becoming security champion for the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Designed and developed features for data pipelines, including unification, storage, parallelization, aggregation and general processing of data from MS support line in NRT and historical views. Used SQL, KQL, Spark and Azure Technologies, processing over 10 gigabytes of data a day.
●	Created Power BI reports, separating data, logic and views into layers for reusability. Reports were used by over 500 call centers’ business managers.
●	Fostered EiC community by leading communication and working life mentoring circles for 10 early in career engineers. Topics included work/life balance, how to communicate with leadership and setting professional long-term objectives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built, mantained and tested backend services for support operations in Python and Google Protobuf. Services impacted all of Lyft users.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Designs, implements and tests web microservices for use within company's internal and public website's use, interacting with MySQL databases using Python 3, Sqlalchemy and Flask.
Implements and tests React and Zend components for public website, managing user information, interaction and routing, receiving over 5000 new users per month.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Defines a common standard for OO-Languages including Java and C#, 
•	Tests each languages’ limits and behaviors in primitive types and data structures such as queues, stacks and arrays.
•	Inspects code classes from co-workers for syntax, logic and design errors. 
•	Standard is used in every project within company for quality standards.

courses.name: SCRUM Scheme for the Execution of Projects.

honors.title: Mejor egresado en Ingeniería en Sistemas Computacionales del campus 2019
honors.description: The Asociación Nacional de Facultades y Escuelas de Ingeniería (ANFEI) gives this reward to the best student in CS or related for each school and campus which offers said career.

honors.title: Estudiante de Excelencia
honors.description: Academic Excellence Award for obtaining a 95-99/100 grade across all semester up to December 2019

projects.title: Think-in' Green
projects.description: Designed and implemented an application in Java for Google Play Store. Features included database connection for users and info using Parse, user’s location and saving of local settings, along with the display of external web pages and videos. Application used for informing people about ways to reduce trash and recycle.

projects.title: BotScape
projects.description: Designed levels, logic and implemented a platform game using JAVA, OOD and libGDX for Android, emulating life-like physics for gameplay
